message:
Partial refunds were refunding too much because `percent` is 0–100 but `partialRefund` multiplied the amount by it directly. A 50% refund of 1250 came out as 62500 instead of 625.

I changed `src/payments/partial-refund.js` to divide by 100, so it now computes `Math.round(payment.amount * percent / 100)`. `npm test` passes all 20 tests, including `test/payments-partial-refund.test.js`.
